title: Apple TV Bulks Up With Video Podcasts
summary: Video podcasts that are available via the Apple Podcasts app will now be available to watch within the Apple TV app, and users can pick up where they left off regardless of which app they use.

title: Grammys: Michael J. Fox, Tim Curry, ‘Wicked: For Good,’ ‘The Pitt’ Among Hollywood Nominees
summary: The 2027 noms were revealed Monday morning.

title: Dolly Parton Lands Three Posthumous Grammy Nominations
summary: With the reveal of the 2027 Grammy nominations on Monday, Parton now has 58 total noms.

title: Taylor Swift Scores Five Grammy Nominations, Including Album and Record of the Year Nods
summary: Swift‘s 'The Life of a Showgirl' album and track for 'Toy Story 5' are among the nominations for the February 2027 show.

title: 2027 Grammys: Madonna Lands Five Nods, Misses Out on Major Categories
summary: The pop superstar makes a long-awaited return to music's biggest night by nabbing five nods for 'Confessions II,' her 16-song follow up to the 2005 chart-topping original, ‘Confessions.’

title: Ariana Grande Lands Four Grammy Nominations, Including Song of the Year Nod, After “Taking a Step Back From Visibility”
summary: The nominations come months after the 'Wicked' star released her eighth studio album, 'Petal,' and wrapped up her Eternal Sunshine Tour.

title: Harry Styles Shut Out of the 2027 Grammy Nominations
summary: The British singer has previously won three Grammys and recently wrapped up his 30-show residency at New York's Madison Square Garden.

title: Melissa Gorga to Debut ‘Sunday Sauce’ Video Podcast This December (Exclusive)
summary: The launch of the new podcast arrives just in time for the return of 'The Real Housewives of New Jersey.'

title: Former NBA Star Jalen Rose Launching Sports and Culture Talk Show “Pop The Trunk” (Exclusive)
summary: The ex-ESPN analyst will have skits, interviews, live performances and more in his new show, which will stream on YouTube.

title: Kino Lorber Takes U.S. Rights to ‘Edward Said: Between Worlds’ (Exclusive)
